description: Channel id inventory (spec §7.3, §14.4). Public sample ids only; private entries are recorded as an id pattern (9 = digit, a = letter), never as a value (spec §23.4). Recorded 2026-10-26.

statsbomb.overlap_evidence: pining statsbomb provenance 'redistributed' is StatsBomb open-data 360 for six tournaments, so its ids are open-data match ids

pining.form: string of digits; owner tier only, every entry private on 2026-10-26 (327 entries, provenances original and redistributed)
pining.evidence: GET /v1/statsbomb/matches with the owner token, 2026-10-26; the public token lists 0 entries

statsbomb.canonical: the decimal string of the integer, for example 3788741 and '3788741' both give '3788741'

idsse.overlap_evidence: the 7 public pining IDSSE entries are the 7 matches of the public HF dataset

public.form: bare DFL MatchId in the pysport/idsse-data file names
public.evidence: HF dataset pysport/idsse-data; v1 Lakebase dev_gold.dim_matches_synced (J03WMX, J03WN1)

pining.form: DFL-MAT- prefix plus the DFL MatchId
pining.evidence: GET /v1/idsse/matches with the public token, 2026-10-26 (7 public entries)

idsse.canonical: the bare DFL MatchId (v1 idsse_native_match_id): strip the DFL-MAT- prefix

skillcorner.overlap_evidence: the 20 public pining SkillCorner entries carry the GitHub opendata match ids

pining.form: numeric string, equal to the GitHub id for public entries
pining.evidence: GET /v1/skillcorner/matches with the public token (20 public) and the owner token (909 entries, 889 private), 2026-10-26

gradientsports.overlap_evidence: pining gradientsports lists 64 private 'original' entries with 4- or 5-digit ids, and the public Drive dataset (FIFA World Cup 2022) has 64 matches with 4- or 5-digit ids

public.form: numeric string (Drive file and metadata match id)
public.evidence: public Drive folder 1_a_q1e9CXeEPJ3GdCv_3-rNO3gPqacfa; v1 Lakebase dev_gold.dim_matches_synced (64 rows, id length 4 to 5)

pining.form: string of digits (pining entries carry string ids for gradientsports)
pining.evidence: GET /v1/gradientsports/matches with the owner token, 2026-10-26 (64 private entries); the public token lists 0 entries

gradientsports.canonical: the numeric string as delivered (identity); an integer input gives its decimal string
